prompt: Who was the captain of the second mission that flew to the moon
response: It seems there might be some confusion in your question. The Apollo 11 mission was the first mission to land humans on the Moon, and it was commanded by Neil Armstrong. The Apollo 12 mission was the second mission to land humans on the Moon, and it was commanded by Charles "Pete" Conrad. So, the captain (or more accurately, the commander) of the second mission to the Moon was Charles "Pete" Conrad.
